title: 首次强制修改密码
prompt:
Draw one standalone 1490 × 1056 static authentication screen using the supplied reference and common style, without the authenticated business sidebar. This is the mandatory password-change checkpoint for internal user li.min, displayed as 李敏. It is not voluntary account settings and not customer registration. Keep a single centered form with a clear heading, a short mandatory-mode explanation, and three vertically aligned inputs.

Show current password, new password, and confirmation as masked values, each with an accessible visibility control. The demonstration values satisfy the existing application policy; do not invent minimum length, composition rules, expiry periods, or recovery mechanisms. Present the existing policy as the same validation treatment used by the ordinary A03 form. The screenshot is a completed entry awaiting submission, not a success result. The primary button saves the new password; the secondary action exits to login. Do not show cancel, return to workbench, navigation links, search, or assistant access that could imply bypass.

State that business access requires successful password change. The static scene must not claim a save, session revocation, or authentication request has already succeeded. Preserve the ordinary form’s spacing and hierarchy while making this mandatory mode unmistakable. Show internal-use and DEMO annotations; no real credentials, password recovery, public signup, or customer data.

Exact visible Chinese copy:
品牌「业务工作台」；标题「首次登录，请修改密码」；身份「李敏 · 内部账号」；说明「修改成功后才能进入系统。」；字段「当前密码」「新密码」「确认新密码」；校验「两次输入一致」；按钮「退出登录」「保存新密码」；提示「仅供内部员工使用 · DEMO」。
required_content: A03 强制模式，账号 li.min / 李敏；无客户注册
当前/新/确认密码均遮蔽，能显示/隐藏；不编造新的密码规则
必须成功修改才可进入系统；无取消返回工作台的绕过路径
保存新密码 / 退出登录；此画面尚未提交
与既有 A03 主动改密同结构但返回行为不同

title: 会话已失效
prompt:
Draw one standalone 1490 × 1056 static global session-expiry state using the supplied reference and common style. This is a confirmed expired session, not a network timeout, authorization denial, or uncertain identity recheck. Replace authenticated business content with a clean recovery surface. Keep only the product identity and a compact, central explanatory panel. Do not leave customer names, account numbers, attachments, email bodies, or editable forms visible behind a translucent overlay.

Use a clear expired-session heading and one primary action to return to the existing A02 internal login page. Show that this occurred while an editing view had unsaved input, but describe that input only generically. Warn that it was not submitted and may need to be entered again. Do not promise persistent server drafts, silent autosave, automatic replay of the previous write, or guaranteed input restoration after login. There is no successful save in this scene.

The destination is the existing login flow, with no account creation, password reset workflow, or permanent loading spinner. Avoid a retry-identity action here because this session is already known invalid; that belongs to a separate temporary verification-failure scene. Keep the explanation concise and visually distinct from the existing unsaved-leave confirmation. Only reauthentication restores eligibility to access protected content; the prototype does not assert that the login has already occurred.

Exact visible Chinese copy:
品牌「业务工作台」；标题「登录已失效」；说明「请重新登录后继续使用。」；提醒「此页面有未保存的输入，尚未提交；重新登录后可能需要重新填写。」；按钮「重新登录」；注记「DEMO · 静态状态示例」。
required_content: 已确定会话失效，不与暂时身份复核失败混用
保护内容不再可见；不在透明遮罩后露客户/文件/邮件
唯一恢复主入口重新登录→既有 A02
未保存输入尚未提交，可能重新填写；无服务器草稿承诺或写入重放
不新增注册/找回密码/自动保存能力

title: 身份复核暂时失败
prompt:
Draw one standalone 1490 × 1056 static global identity-verification failure state using the supplied reference and common style. This is a temporary failure to confirm the current internal session, not proof that the password is wrong, the account is disabled, or the session has expired. Show the shared shell’s product header and neutral navigation outline, but with protected content replaced by a simple recovery panel.

Use an inline failure message and a clear retry action, with an explicit secondary return-to-login action. No permanent dimmer, endless spinner, exposed customer details, business action buttons, or misleading signed-in success badge should remain. The panel explains that identity could not be verified because of a temporary connection problem and protected actions are paused until verification succeeds. Do not make the page a broad HTTP 403 or server-error replacement.

There was an unsaved edit before verification failed. Show only a generic warning that no submission occurred; do not display the edited private fields or promise that the server stored a draft. Retrying verification must not imply replaying an earlier business write. If the user chooses login instead, the existing authentication path applies. Keep this scene visibly different from confirmed session expiry through its cause, primary action, and lack of a definitive logged-out claim. It is a static demonstration of a recoverable state, not a successful reconnect.

Exact visible Chinese copy:
品牌「业务工作台」；状态「身份暂未确认」；标题「暂时无法完成身份复核」；说明「连接暂时异常，无法确认当前登录状态。」；提醒「身份确认前暂停受保护操作。未保存输入尚未提交。」；按钮「重试身份复核」「返回登录」；注记「DEMO · 静态状态示例」。
required_content: 映射 coverage A01-session-expired 中另一种原因，不新建一级页
临时连接异常≠会话已失效/账号停用/密码错误
重试身份复核为主、返回登录为次；不永久遮罩
敏感主区隐藏，受保护操作暂停；未保存未提交
重试不重放业务写入，不声称已经恢复连接

title: 窄屏单栏客户详情与导航入口
prompt:

This is one interface, not a collage, phone mockup, or second desktop comparison. Use the supplied customer reference and common style. Demonstrate existing narrow navigation behavior, not a separate mobile product.

Show the compact product header with a menu icon and a clear return-to-customer-list control. The sidebar is collapsed; do not also show a full left rail. Display only the selected customer’s quick detail, not the customer list alongside it. Use Alex Morgan C001 and Northline LLC, with customer completed and current PayPal APP-002 awaiting documents. Show application owner 李敏 only in the application block. Preserve the valid Stripe APP-001 approval dated 10/12/2026 and PayPal start date 10/16/2026.

Arrange contact, company, and website data in a single vertical column with readable labels and ample wrapping. Use northline.example and hello@northline.example without truncation. Provide the existing full-dossier link and copy affordances, but no new business actions. A modest scroll cue can indicate content below; do not compress everything into tiny text. The hamburger is the navigation entry, and returning selects the list as the sole main view. Do not open a second drawer on top or present menu and details as competing focal layers.
